item.title: Russia strikes Ukraine security service headquarters in Kyiv as attacks intensify
item.description: A Russian drone struck the central Kyiv headquarters of Ukraine’s Security Service (SBU) on Friday, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed. item.title: August jobs report crushes expectations with 162,000 payrolls added, stoking rate-hike fears
item.description: The U.S. economy added 162,000 nonfarm payrolls in August, far exceeding the 53,000 to 55,000 economists had expected, the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Friday. The unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%, as forecast. The August gain was the strongest monthly increase since March, and prior…

item.title: Israel's Ben-Gvir sets out plan for forced expulsion of all Palestinians from Gaza
item.description: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has proposed a plan for the forced expulsion of all Palestinians from the Gaza Strip, according to a report from Al Jazeera published on 4 September 2026. item.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to lift block on USPS mail-voting restrictions
item.description: This dispute centers on procedure and authority rather than a final ruling on the merits: the Supreme Court has not yet decided whether Trump's executive order or the USPS rule is lawful, only whether lower courts can pause its implementation while litigation continues. item.title: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner to visit Moscow and Kyiv in renewed Ukraine peace push
item.description: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are expected to arrive in Moscow and Kyiv over the coming days, marking their first trip to Ukraine and the most significant effort in months to revive negotiations to end Russia’s war on Ukraine, according to officials and statements from both sides.

item.title: Diesel prices hit record high as Ukraine and Iran wars constrict supply
item.description: The price of diesel fuel hit a record high Friday, reaching an average of $5.85 per gallon nationwide, according to AAA's gas price tracker.
